blurb: Thanks to our generous supporters, The Patagonia Museum, an all-volunteer organization, has established an investment fund with the Arizona Community Foundation. The non-endowed Encino Blanco Fund aims to reach a million-dollar balance so the organization can establish a paid "Executive Director" position using the fund's dividends.
